limits.standardQuote: An individual crewmember’s total career effective radiation dose due to spaceflight radiation exposure shall be less than 600 mSv. This limit is universal for all ages and sexes.
limits.briefQuote: An individual crewmember’s total career effective radiation dose due to spaceflight radiation exposure shall be less than 600 mSv. This limit is universal for all ages and sexes.
limits.context: Career space permissible exposure limit; universal for all ages and sexes; not an organ-dose limit.

limits.standardQuote: The program shall protect crewmembers from exposure to the design reference Solar Particle Event (SPE) environment proton energy spectrum (sum of the October 1989 events) to less than an effective dose of 250 mSv.
limits.briefQuote: The program shall protect crewmembers from exposure to the design reference Solar Particle Event (SPE) environment proton energy spectrum (sum of the October 1989 events) to less than a NASA effective dose of 250 mSv.
limits.context: Design reference SPE environment proton energy spectrum (sum of the October 1989 events); not a personal dose measurement or a current-event estimate.

semantics.csaNote: CSA radiation material is catalogued separately and is not substituted for these NASA effective-dose values.
notes: Only NASA effective dose in mSv is stored here.
Organ-dose or equivalent-dose conversions are out of scope.
The SPE value applies to the design reference spectrum, not a personal dose or current event.
No clinical action, diagnosis, or treatment is implied.
